subject: Tailored 20-min session to review your usage uptick
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel@neurolytics.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Tailored 20-min session to review your usage uptick

Hi Daniel —

I’m Kimberly on the SDR team at Redwood Inference. Our telemetry flagged a nice uptick from Neurolytics this week (noticed ~520k tokens across API keys tied to your domain). Congrats — looks like you’re running some interesting experiments.

Quick ask: would you be open to a short 20-minute walkthrough where we can:
- Confirm whether the pattern is test traffic or real production traffic
- Share a couple quick suggestions to reduce unit cost (batching + KV hints)
- Show an example of a canary rollout for model variants

Proposed times (PT):
- Thu Jun 15, 10:00–10:20am
- Thu Jun 15, 2:00–2:20pm
- Fri Jun 16, 9:30–9:50am

If none of those work, send a time that does and I’ll loop in a solutions engineer. I’ve attached a one-pager with a short blurb on our Dedicated and Hosted options for context.

Thanks — looking forward to helping your team get the most out of the spike.

—
Kimberly Park
SDR, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.ai
[Attachment: redwood-overview-onepager.pdf (PDF, 420 KB)]

From: Daniel Cho <daniel@neurolytics.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tailored 20-min session to review your usage uptick

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the heads up and for the one-pager. Yeah, that usage spike is real — we kicked off a small pilot for a real-time annotation pipeline and it looks promising. Happy to take a quick run-through.

Thursday at 10:00am PT works for me, but can we stretch to 25 minutes? I want to include our ML lead (just to make sure they hear the rollout recommendation).

Agenda request:
- Quick look at the traffic pattern you saw
- Cost & latency suggestions specific to streaming inference
- Next steps / who from our side should be involved

I’ve CC’d only myself for now; I’ll add our ML lead after we confirm.

—
Daniel Cho
Head of ML Platforms, Neurolytics
daniel@neurolytics.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel@neurolytics.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tailored 20-min session to review your usage uptick

Hi Daniel —

Great — thanks for confirming. 25 minutes is fine. I’m Monica (Solutions Engineering); I’ll join to walk through traffic patterns and a short playbook for streaming inference. Vivek (cc’d) can speak to Dedicated capacity if it looks like you’ll need predictable throughput.

Proposed quick agenda (keeps us tight):
1) 3 min — who’s on the call / signal we saw
2) 10 min — traffic breakdown & immediate wins (batching/KV caching)
3) 7 min — rollout options (canary + fallback)
4) 5 min — next steps & potential POC scope

I’ve attached a short mutual action plan template that we can use to capture owners & timing. If you add your ML lead on the reply we’ll include them in the calendar invite.

Calendar options (PT): Thu Jun 15, 10:00–10:25 — confirmed by Kimberly as first choice
Alternate: Thu Jun 15, 14:00–14:25

We’ll send a calendar invite once we have final attendee list.

Best,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: neurolytics-mutual-action-plan.pdf (PDF, 85 KB)]

From: Daniel Cho <daniel@neurolytics.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tailored 20-min session to review your usage uptick

Thanks — I’ve looped in Priya Reddy (priya@neurolytics.ai), our ML lead. Thu Jun 15 10:00–10:25 PT is good for us.

Priya — joining details to follow; Monica/Vivek/Kimberly will send an invite. Looking forward to the cost/latency suggestions.
